The '''Embrace''' was a series of caverns on [[Aing-Tii homeworld|the homeworld]] of the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Aing-Tii gathered sacred artifacts that they were forbidden to touch, which they called [[relics]], and placed them in the Embrace.

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled with his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to learn more about [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]'s fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They were trained in the art of [[flow-walking]] and [[Fold space|teleportation]] by the Aing-Tii [[Tadar'Ro]]. Tadar'Ro led the Skywalkers to the Embrace, where he hoped that they would discover an important revelation to help settle the rift that had recently split the Aing-Tii. Inside the Embrace, Skywalker found the [[Codex]], a relic which Caedus&mdash;at the time known as Jacen Solo&mdash;had touched during his stay with the Aing-Tii.

To the disappointment of Tadar'Ro and the other Aing-Tii, the Embrace revealed no revelation for the species.
